content.comment_body: Hello everyone. Is it possible to connect [product_name] simulation software directly with another program such as LabVIEW, without using actual hardware, and only simulating the variables? I have successfully set up this kind of communication before using LabVIEW and other PLC simulation tools with their respective libraries. Does anyone know of any DLL or third-party tool that works with [product_name] simulation software? Thanks.
I am not aware of any software solutions that offer this functionality.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to simulate communication between LabVIEW and [product_name] simulation software to exchange variables without real hardware. They reference successful experiences with other PLC simulation environments that offer such capabilities but observe a lack of direct or third-party support for [product_name] simulation software. Responses indicate that this kind of integration is not currently available for the product.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] simulation software to offer APIs, DLLs, or third-party solutions for external simulated software communication, enabling integration with platforms like LabVIEW.
